rows.title: That Prince Is A Girl: The Princess And Her Grand King
rows.sourceSynopsis: To protect her sister, Emeriel disguises herself as a male servant when both sisters are sold as slaves to the beasts kingdom of Urai. But Emeriel is no ordinary human, she's a rare Syren, the only one who can calm the beast king Daemonikai in his feral state, and they secretly fall for each other. As the jealous Sinai torments her, the ambitious lord Zaiper schemes against her, and the cursed Vladya becomes obsessed with her sister, Emeriel fights to keep her identity hidden while navigating deadly traps. In the end, she breaks the beast-king's curse unexpectedly.

rows.title: My Alien Life
rows.sourceSynopsis: Rachel, an 18‑year‑old human girl, is captured by aliens and sold as a slave. Five strong alien males—Damien, Evan, Bane, Kein, and Christof—buy her and rename her Ciara. They force themselves on her. She is desperate at first, but her body still reacts. When she is rescued by native females, she finds herself pregnant, and the five males are put up for sale. She buys them—not as slaves, but as workers—and they escort her home through a special pass. She returns home with a daughter who carries alien blood, along with memories of her life among the aliens.

rows.title: The Secret of Gala Night
rows.sourceSynopsis: To repay her debts, Elena was forced to work as a waitress at a luxury yacht party. In the dim lower deck, she accidentally had a one-night stand with Dominic Kane, the heir of a top wealthy family who had been drugged and was barely conscious. The pitch-black night hid their faces from each other, and they parted ways without ever knowing who the other was. The next day, Elena was inexplicably fired, leaving her utterly desperate. To make a living, she applied to become the personal nanny for a five-year-old boy named Leo, unaware that her employer was the very man from that night, the true head of the Kane Group, Dominic.

rows.title: Omega and Alpha: Fatal or Fated?
rows.sourceSynopsis: Ava is a seemingly ordinary Omega girl in the Pack, yet it happens her destined mate is Ian, the future Alpha of the Pack. Ian refuses her publicly at first, but fate still brings him to fall for her eventually. However, his previous refusal triggered a curse that makes Ava keep getting weaker. In the crisis, a mysterious man comes to Ava and reveals her true origins, one that may tear her and Ian apart.

rows.title: Came Back Hotter With Lord's Twins
rows.sourceSynopsis: Jodi carried the blood of dragonslayers and an ugly birthmark. Her fiancé Paul abandoned her for it. Then she met Nick, the Lord of the Burning Realm, cursed to burn alive for a century. Her touch was the only thing that could stop the fire. One night, she walked away pregnant with twins. Five years later, Jodi returned to the Dragon Lands for her daughters. Her mark faded, her face changed, and she became unrecognizable. But Melody had poisoned Nick's mind with lies, and her own family attacked her at every turn. When Nick finally uncovered the truth, he found his fated mate in the woman he'd wronged. They tore through conspiracies, saved their daughters, and claimed each other.

rows.title: Love After Divorce: My Ex-husband Wants Me Back
rows.sourceSynopsis: After three years of a loveless marriage, Adeline decides to leave Brandon. She once devoted herself to him, endured his indifference, but all her patience and love went down the drain. After leaving him, Adeline relauches her career as an independent interior designer, a part of her that Brandon never really understood. Meanwhile, Brandon slowly realizes how much he needs Adeline when all the care, companionship, and quiet sacrifices he once took for granted suddenly disappear. When they unexpectedly meet again through a business project, he no longer sees the timid wife who waited for him at home. She is professional, confident, and determined to move forward. Brandon begins to regret his past choices, but winning her back requires more than that.

rows.title: Oops, My Father's BFF Is In My Bed
rows.sourceSynopsis: Evelyn had secretly loved Jacob, her father's best friend, for five years. On the eve of her father's wedding, Jacob returned, and Evelyn made her move. He resisted, bound by loyalty and age, until one night by the pool, he broke. Their forbidden affair burned bright, but Evelyn's mother forced Jacob to end it, and his ex twisted the knife. Jacob played along, breaking Evelyn's heart to protect her from worse. When the truth came out, Jacob faced her father's fury. But in the end, moved by real love, he gave them his blessing. Age, guilt, and fear fell away. Jacob and Evelyn finally stood together, no longer hiding.

rows.title: His Secretary By Day, His Secret By Night
rows.sourceSynopsis: Blair returned from a business trip early, only to find her fiancé Dan in bed with her cousin Laura. Heartbroken and drunk, she ended up at the office with her billionaire boss Roman, one night that sparked a secret office affair. But her enemies wouldn't let go: Dan wouldn't stop begging, Roman's manipulative ex-wife Jessica circled back, and her aunt Vivian staged a family trap to force her back to Dan. Roman crashed the dinner, exposed Dan and Laura's affair and Laura's pregnancy, and shattered the lies. With Jessica blackmailing them over their secret office romance, Roman dropped to one knee, not to run, but to claim her for good.

rows.title: Their War, Our Fate
rows.sourceSynopsis: Ten years ago, Prince Caelum of Vorrath and Prince Seren of Lysara made a vow of love on the Stargazer's Perch. But Seren's father Korrath attacked Caelum's homeland and massacred his entire family. Korrath even made Seren kill Caelum himself. Seren deliberately avoided the vital points. Ten years later, a masked man returns with a fleet and kills Korrath. He is Caelum, and he's here to make Seren his slave. The blood-soaked misunderstanding awaits to be resolved.

rows.title: The Prince Is A Girl: The Slave In A Princess Disguise
rows.sourceSynopsis: To protect her sister, Emeriel disguises herself as a male servant when both sisters are sold as slaves to the beasts kingdom of Urai. But Emeriel is no ordinary human, she's a rare Syren, the only one who can calm the beast-king Daemonikai in his feral state, and they secretly fall for each other. As the jealous Sinai torments her, the ambitious lord Zaiper schemes against her, and the cursed Vladya becomes obsessed with her sister, Emeriel fights to keep her identity hidden while navigating deadly traps. No one expected, in the end, she breaks the beast-king's curse...

rows.title: Married My Ex's Dad, Now I'm Mafia Queen
rows.sourceSynopsis: Isabella is dumped at the altar by her fiancé Alex. To save her dignity and get revenge, she marries his father, Damien, the most powerful mafia boss. After the marriage, with her sharp wit and growing influence, she tears down her ex, reclaims her mother's stolen fortune, crushes family betrayals, and rises from an abandoned bride to a mafia queen. Along the way, a cold contract marriage with Damien turns into something real, a fierce, unstoppable love.

rows.title: Left at the Altar, Married Power
rows.sourceSynopsis: Linsey was overjoyed to marry her fiancé Felix, until he was called away by a single phone call from that homewrecker. Humiliated at her own wedding, Linsey hit rock bottom. Then the homewrecker called again, just to gloat. But Linsey didn't cry. She turned around, walked outside the church, and married the first man she saw. As fate would have it, he turned out to be the most powerful man in the city...

rows.title: Mated To My Boyfriend's Brother
rows.sourceSynopsis: Sophia, an Omega, finds out her boy friend Bruce cheated with her bestie Louisa, before her eighteenth birthday. But soon, she finds out Bruce's brother Bryan, the Alpha, is her destined mate. It is on Bryan's engagement banquet, and her words ruin it. Bryan is furious and sacks her brother, which causes her mother to get sick. To save her family, Sophia becomes his personal secretary. He is cold to her, yet his wolf longs for her. After conflicts and crises, they forge real feelings and form a real mate bond.

rows.title: The King's Physician Bride
rows.sourceSynopsis: Hilwyn, a noble healer who despises aristocratic constraints, treats King Lucien for a chronic poisoning that has been mistaken for impotence. To protect his secret and avoid marriage pressure, Lucien proposes a contractual marriage, eighty thousand gold coins, no interference, and separate lives. But their constant bickering masks an unexpected bond. As Hilwyn risks everything to detoxify him and proves her skill before the royal court, Lucien moves from cold indifference to possessive devotion. When he tears up their contract and confesses his heart, Hilwyn must choose between her hard-won independence and a love she never anticipated...

rows.title: The Trophy Wife's War
rows.sourceSynopsis: With Julian as her shield, Seraphina fights back using hidden reserves, intelligence contacts, and tactical brilliance. But her ultimate goal is not just victory—it is finding her little sister, "Nine," sold to traffickers years ago. The hunt has just begun.

rows.title: His Neglected Wife Is The Top Scientist
rows.sourceSynopsis: June, a genius scientist, gave up her career to marry Cole. She did this for love, yet Cole neglected her. When she was bleeding out from miscarriage, he was with his mistress Alycia. June lost her child, her ability to conceive, and her love for him. She started research again, tackled Cole's slander, and took back her stolen works. She was still the top scientist.

rows.title: Reborn, I Choose The Other Groom
rows.sourceSynopsis: In her past life, Cathy made her adopted brother Rory marry her. Her stepsister Marlee, in love with Rory, killed herself. Rory was furious and accidentally killed Cathy. Reborn before the wedding, Cathy chooses to let Marlee have Rory, and takes on the family duty of marrying Nate, the crippled son of the Moss family. After marriage, Cathy finds that Nate's disability is actually caused by his uncle Theo and stepmother Martha. The couple take back family power and punish the villains, forming a true family with love and children, leaving Rory in regret.

rows.title: Designing My New Life
rows.sourceSynopsis: Thea and Chase had been married for three years, but misunderstandings and interference from Lily tore the couple apart. After enduring countless grievances, Thea resolutely filed for divorce, dedicated herself to her talent in fashion design, and rebuilt her career in the fashion world, reclaiming her dreams and achieving success. Chase, after facing life-threatening dangers, finally recognized his true feelings and went all out to make amends. Through hardships, they resolved every misunderstanding, broke down all barriers, and reunited through mutual understanding and redemption, ultimately finding complete happiness together.

rows.title: Marrying The Merman King
rows.sourceSynopsis: Vivian is a simple woman who wants a test-tube baby, yet she accidentally carries the baby of William, king of the merfolk. Betrayed by her family and fiancé, she has no choice but to marry Willaim and go live with him in the Deep Sea Palace. The merfolk reject a human queen, and many noble ladies covet William. Vivian works hard to establish herself among the hostilities, and true feelings emerge between the couple.

rows.title: Secret Triplets: Second Chance With My Billionaire
rows.sourceSynopsis: On the day of her mother's funeral, Cailin Morton witnesses her fiancé Hilliard Holloway returning home with his mistress Charla. Heartbroken, she fakes a miscarriage and leaves him, raising her three genius children with him alone. After their reunion, the children team up to prank their father. Hilliard gradually discovers the children are his. Charla tries to frame her, but the couple eventually resolves all misunderstandings. The man wins back his wife and children, and the family lives happily ever after.

rows.title: Weak Yesterday, Unstoppable Today
rows.sourceSynopsis: Zen, heir of the House Blackwood, was betrayed and sold into slavery by his own family, until he awakened the Prometheus Fire, a power that turned his wounds into strength. He escaped and joined the temple trials to find his sister Yana, who was exiled to the frozen wastes. Against rival nobles like Perrin and shadowy conspiracies, Zen survived deadly trials, earned the favor of Frost Tower's master Aura, and uncovered an ancient tome in the Stardust Corridor. As he grew stronger, he peeled back the lies behind his family's fall and his sister's banishment. Every scar made him sharper, every enemy brought him closer to the truth, and to the throne that was stolen from him.
